review: I’ve just finished a 4-lesson bundle with Alan, a gift from my parents, and I can’t recommend him highly enough.  In the first lesson we went back to basics: the exposure triangle (shutter speed, aperture and ISO), white balance, and how to handle different shooting situations. It was a lot to take in, but it gave me a really solid foundation. Next we covered depth of field and how the f-stop controls how much of the image is sharp. Alan suggested I switch to aperture priority, which felt like relearning my camera, but it made a real difference to my photos. The third lesson was about lighting, with a still life homework project that was challenging but taught me a lot. In the final lesson we looked at the bigger picture: how to tell a story with a photo, what to include and what to leave out, when to take the shot, and how changing the angle or lighting can change the whole story of a scene.  What makes Alan stand out is his feedback. Each lesson started with a review of my homework, and he’s a no-nonsense teacher who tells you honestly what’s working and what isn’t. That has helped me improve more than anything else. I came away far more observant and intentional with my shots.  Thank you, Alan. I hope to come back one day with a portfolio of professional-looking work. Highly recommended to anyone who wants to improve their photography!

I recently attended Alan Ranger’s photography workshop in Padley Gorge and Bolehill quarry, and it was an excellent experience from start to finish. Alan is incredibly friendly and approachable, creating a comfortable learning environment for photographers of all skill levels. One aspect I particularly appreciated was the individual attention he gave to every participant. Rather than following a one-size-fits-all approach, he provided customised guidance based on each person's experience level, helping everyone get the most out of the workshop. The workshop was very well organised and ran exactly to schedule, which reflected Alan’s professionalism and respect for participants' time. The outdoor shooting locations were carefully chosen and offered perfect opportunities to practise different photography techniques in real-world conditions. What stood out most was learning to see photography from a completely different perspective. Alan’s vast experience and deep knowledge of the craft were evident throughout the day, and the insights he shared went far beyond camera settings and technical aspects. Overall, this workshop was absolutely worth the money. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced photographer looking to refine your skills, Alan’s rich experience, practical teaching style, and personalised approach make this workshop highly recommended.  Thank you Alan!
